_notes: Transcribed from Titan sheet scans AK0291-AK0297.
Triskelion stats (rulebook p.11): DANGER (A-in-hex icon), RAGE (Ω), FATE (Ψ). Trauma Table thresholds are indexed by current DANGER.
Trauma tiers: 1 arrow = Minor, 2 arrows = Major, 3 arrows = Grave, skull = Obol draw.
Kratos Table: row = Rage value reached; entries are the Kratos Table Abilities unlocked at that Rage (left/right = two separate options, '+' = both together on one entry).
Rush ability prefix '[DANGER 2+] Ψ' read as: requires Danger 2+, costs Fate (Ψ) - cost amount TBC against rulebook p.54 Free/Fate abilities; it consumes both the Move and Attack actions.
Cycle I Gamechanger (AK0298) and Cycle V Titans DK2001-DK2004 added (Kratos tables from the sheet backs). The person-with-up-arrow icon is Scale; the hand+sword icon is Clutch.

Cycle V (EK/DK20xx) Titans added 2026-10-30 from sheet photos: Immortal Truthbearer, Helldiver, Feareater, Executioner, Trespasser. Ambrosia Limit N → ambrosiaLimit = N-4 (modifier). Feareater "+1 Power" sheet icon → Raw Power 1. Oxygen/Aether/Light/Deny only matter in Cycle V Primordial battles.

kratosAbilities.Power Re-roll X: During the Power Roll step of an Attack, you may re-roll up to X Power dice.
kratosAbilities.Break X: During the second ability window, place X Break tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Break token in the Kratos Pool allows the attacking Titan to turn 1 Potential symbol into 1 Power.
kratosAbilities.Opening X: During the second ability window, place X Opening tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Attack Roll step, each Opening token in the Kratos Pool adds +1 to the result of each attack die.
kratosAbilities.Pushback X: Turn towards the Primordial. Then, move towards it, pushing it X spaces in a straight line. Usable in either the first or second ability window.
kratosAbilities.Additional Power Die: When performing the Power Roll, add 1 Power die to your Power Pool.
kratosAbilities.Reposition X: During the second ability window, move up to X spaces.
kratosAbilities.Vault: If you're adjacent to the Primordial, place your miniature on an empty space in a straight line from you, on the opposite side of the Primordial, adjacent to it. Usable in either the first or second ability window.
kratosAbilities.Motivate X: During the second ability window, choose another Titan. That Titan may move up to X spaces.
kratosAbilities.Provoke: During the first ability window, gain the Priority Target token and turn the Primordial to face you.
kratosAbilities.Diversion: During the second ability window, place a Diversion token in the Kratos Pool. An attacking Titan may use a Diversion token from the Kratos Pool to ignore Fail Responses until the end of their Attack.
kratosAbilities.Overbreak X: During the second ability window, if your Total Power exceeds AT by 1 or more, place X Break tokens in the Kratos Pool.
kratosAbilities.Elation X: During the second ability window, you may discard X Despair tokens or Ambrosia tokens to place X Opening tokens in the Kratos Pool.
kratosAbilities.Tireless: When you are about to activate the Cumbersome keyword, you may ignore it.
kratosAbilities.Fire X: During the second ability window, place X Fire tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Fire token allows the attacking Titan to turn 1 Potential into 1 Power. You must use as many Fire tokens as possible, but you may first use Break tokens. Remove used Fire tokens afterwards. If, during the Clear the Kratos Pool step, there are unused Fire tokens, remove 1 of them and leave the rest.
kratosAbilities.Black X: During the second ability window, place X Black tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Black token allows the attacking Titan to re-roll 1 Power die. You may change 1 Potential into 1 Power on each Power die re-rolled this way (as if you used a Break token on it).
kratosAbilities.Hope X: During the second ability window, place X Hope tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Power Roll step, each Hope token allows the attacking Titan to turn 1 Potential or blank (●) symbol into 1 Power.
kratosAbilities.Heartseeker: During the Draw BP card step of the Attack, you may look at the top 2 BP cards and choose which one to attack. Shuffle the other card back into the deck.
kratosAbilities.Additional Die Improvement: Your Additional Power Die becomes a black die instead.
kratosAbilities.Rouse X: During the second ability window, place X Rouse tokens in the Kratos Pool. Each Rouse token in the Kratos Pool allows the attacking Titan to treat their Rage as 1 higher until the end of the Attack. This effect cannot cause a Titan to die by increasing their Rage over 9.
kratosAbilities.Burden X: Take X Condition, Despair or Ambrosia tokens from the nearest Titan.
kratosAbilities.Succor: During another Titan's Power Roll, if, after applying all bonuses, they fail to meet the AT by exactly 1 Power and the Primordial is within your Weapon's effective range, you may gain +1 Rage, gain the Fatigue token and discard that Weapon, to add +1 Power to that Power Roll.
kratosAbilities.Pass X: During the Clear the Kratos Pool step, choose up to X Kratos tokens to remain in the Kratos Pool. You can only choose Opening or Break tokens.
kratosAbilities.Greater Pass X: During the Clear the Kratos Pool step, choose up to X Kratos tokens to remain in the Kratos Pool.
kratosAbilities.Inspire X: During the first ability window, choose up to X knocked down Titans. They may immediately stand up.
kratosAbilities.BP Suppress: When you deal a Wound, shuffle the BP discard pile into the BP deck.
kratosAbilities.Raw Power X: When performing the Power Roll, gain +X Power.
kratosAbilities.Assist X (무기 키워드): During another Titan's Power Roll, if, after applying all bonuses, they fail to meet the AT, if the Primordial is within your weapon's effective range, you may gain +1 Rage and a Combat Fatigue token, to immediately add X Break tokens to the Kratos Pool. This ability can only be used if it will allow the Attacker to Wound.
kratosAbilities.Fatigue: Combat Fatigue token: as long as you have it, you can use your combat action only to discard this token. You cannot gain a Fatigue token if you already have one.
kratosAbilities.Scale X: When you attack, if you're adjacent to the Primordial, you may immediately Climb a VP, move to an adjacent VP X times or move X spaces up on the Endless Staircase.
kratosAbilities.Closing X: During the second ability window, place X Closing tokens in the Kratos Pool. During the Attack Roll step, each Closing token in the Kratos Pool adds +1 to the result of each Attack die and allows the attacking Titan to re-roll 1 Attack die.
kratosAbilities.Pole Position: If you're adjacent to the Primordial, place your miniature on an empty space adjacent to the Primordial. You may use this ability in either the first or second ability window.
kratosAbilities.Unburden X: You may give up to X Condition or Despair or Ambrosia tokens to the closest Titan. You may use this ability in either the first or second ability window.
kratosAbilities.Clutch: During the Power Roll step, if, after applying all bonuses, you fail to meet the AT by exactly 1 Power, you may gain +1 Power, then, when you finish resolving this Attack, immediately discard your active weapon.
kratosAbilities.Precise: After drawing the BP card, you may target the top card of the BP discard pile instead (shuffle the drawn card back).
kratosAbilities.Truth X: During the second ability window, place X tokens in the Kratos Pool. Each of those tokens may be a Break, Opening, Fire, Closing or Black token.
kratosAbilities.AI Suppress: When you deal a Wound, shuffle the AI discard pile into the AI deck.
kratosAbilities.Pull X: Move the Primordial X spaces toward you, along the shortest possible path. If the Primordial is or becomes adjacent to you, the Pull does not end. Instead, move directly away from the Primordial the remaining number of spaces, then finish the Pull. You may use this ability in either the first or second ability window.
kratosAbilities.Auto-rouse X: During the first ability window, place X Rouse tokens in the Kratos Pool.

round: Primordial Round: Draw and resolve an AI card, resolve any additional effects found on the Primordial Sheet or Traits.
Titan Round: Each Titan takes their turn one at a time and performs a Move and an Attack in any order.
aiAttack: Attack: Evasion Roll -> Attack Consequences (effects + Trauma Draw)
titanAttack: Raise Rage and check Priority Target
Power Roll: Create Power Pool -> Roll -> Power Re-rolls -> Use Potentials -> Resolve

abilities.One For All: If your natural Rage goes over 9 during an Attack, perform a normal Attack, but do not draw a BP card. Instead, perform a Power Roll, divide your Total Power by 2 (rounding up) and add +1 Power if you had a Crit Chance. Note the resulting Power, then clear the Kratos Pool and continue to your second ability window (do not resolve any responses). Next time any Titan attacks, it adds the Power you noted to its Total Power.
